application_realization_envelope.narration: The baker shifts again, glancing around before lowering his voice slightly. "It's not that I don't have a favorite," they say cautiously, "but sometimes, some things are better kept private — perhaps for safety or just to avoid stirring troubles." Their gaze lingers briefly on the crowded street beyond before returning to you, firm yet unreadable.
